item.title: Fukushima Peaches: Japan's Finest Momo & Orchard Picking — Guide
item.description: Fukushima is widely regarded as producing some of Japan’s finest peaches (momo), a reputation built on the region’s ideal growing conditions — warm summer days, cool nights and mineral-rich volcanic soil around the Fukushima basin. Dozens of orchards across the prefecture open to visitors each summer for all-you-can-eat picking experiences, offering a range of varieties from early-season to late-season cultivars, each with its own balance of sweetness and juiciness. Neighbouring pear (nashi) orchards often extend the picking season into autumn.
